skill.name: subagent-driven-development
skill.description: Coordinates same-session implementation by assigning each independent task to a fresh subagent, then running spec and code quality reviews.
skill.summary: Run independent development tasks with fresh subagents and structured review loops.

content.value_statement: Independent implementation tasks can lose quality when context and reviews are inconsistent. This skill defines a same-session workflow with fresh subagents, spec checks, and code quality review.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to use fresh subagents for independent implementation tasks.
Provides an implementer prompt template with clarification, testing, commit, and self-review steps.
Provides a spec compliance reviewer template for checking requested work against actual code.
Provides a code quality reviewer handoff using implementation details and commit SHAs.
Describes review loops for fixing spec gaps and quality issues before moving forward.
Lists workflow red flags that prevent skipped reviews or parallel implementation conflicts.
limitations: It does not execute tasks by itself or manage subagents automatically.
It works best when tasks are independent and already written in an implementation plan.
It depends on separate review and test-driven development skills for full workflow coverage.
It can add cost because each task may require multiple subagent invocations.

use_cases.title: Execute a Feature Plan
use_cases.description: Break a prepared feature plan into independent tasks and route each task through implementation and review.

use_cases.title: Improve Review Discipline
use_cases.description: Use separate spec and quality reviewers so completed tasks are checked before the next task starts.

use_cases.title: Reduce Context Drift
use_cases.description: Give each subagent full task context upfront while keeping the controller session focused on coordination.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Small Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use subagent-driven-development for this plan. Extract each independent task, create a task list, and start with the first implementer subagent.

prompt_templates.title: Dispatch One Implementer
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the implementer prompt for Task 2. Include the full task text, required context, working directory, testing expectations, and report format.

prompt_templates.title: Run the Review Loop
prompt_templates.prompt: After the implementer reports back, dispatch a spec compliance reviewer. If approved, dispatch the code quality reviewer with base and head commit SHAs.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Full Branch
prompt_templates.prompt: For this development branch, execute each independent task through fresh implementation, spec review, quality review, fixes, and final branch review.

output_examples.input: Run a three-task plan for a login feature.
output_examples.output: A task list is created, Task 1 is implemented by a fresh subagent, then reviewed for spec compliance and code quality.

output_examples.input: A spec reviewer finds a missing requirement.
output_examples.output: The implementer fixes the gap, the spec reviewer checks again, and the workflow waits before starting quality review.

output_examples.input: All planned tasks pass their review loops.
output_examples.output: A final branch review is requested before development is considered ready to finish.

best_practices: Provide full task text and context so subagents do not need to read the plan file.
Run spec compliance review before code quality review for every task.
Repeat review loops until reported issues are fixed and approved.
anti_patterns: Dispatching multiple implementation subagents in parallel on the same codebase.
Accepting an implementer report without independent code inspection.
Moving to the next task while spec or quality issues remain open.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when you have a written implementation plan with mostly independent tasks to execute in the current session.

faq.question: Does it replace code review?
faq.answer: No. It requires code review after spec compliance passes and keeps review as a separate checkpoint.

faq.question: Can subagents work in parallel?
faq.answer: The skill warns against parallel implementation subagents because concurrent edits can conflict.

faq.question: Why use a fresh subagent for each task?
faq.answer: Fresh subagents reduce context drift and let each task start with focused instructions.

faq.question: What happens when a reviewer finds issues?
faq.answer: The implementer fixes the issue, then the same review stage runs again before the workflow continues.

faq.question: What other skills does it expect?
faq.answer: It references planning, code review, finishing a branch, and test-driven development workflow skills.
